clare (eng-platform): Heads-up: customers see a mismatch between runtime token billing and observability cost for prefix/KV cache hits. Runtime reports near-zero work but obsv attributes full avg cost. Anyone seen this?

diego (runtime): Yup. On cache-hit we short-circuit and skip decode loops. We can emit a small 'work_units' metric per request to reflect actual decode ops.

nina (observability): Historically adding runtime metadata blew up index size. Two patterns: (A) add lightweight fields to trace envelope (cache_hit:boolean, work_units:int) as low-card facets, or (B) keep trace index unchanged and publish a separate compact cost stream keyed by trace_id for reconciliation. B reduces index cardinality but complicates ad-hoc trace joins.

john (billing): We prefer per-request fidelity for accurate invoices, but query perf matters for audits. Is a hybrid possible?

tara (privacy): Any new signal must avoid prompt data or model internals. Numeric flags OK if irreversible.

diego (runtime): Proposal: X-RW-COST-V1 header with packed 3 bytes: 1 bit cache_hit, 7 bits exec_bucket (0..127), 16 bits work_units. Base64 encode to avoid proxy mangling. No free-form text.

nina (observability): Ingest plan: decode header, write to obsv.cost.v1 compact topic for reconciliations and populate two derived low-cardinality fields in trace index: cache_hit (boolean) and cost_bucket (low/med/high). Keep raw messages for 7 days, store per-tenant histograms 90 days.

john (billing): If reconciliation delta > 3% for last billing period we consider backfill adjustments; otherwise forward-only.

diego (runtime): Canary rollout: 1% -> 10% -> 100% over two weeks. Canary will set an LSB flag canary=true for easy filtering.

metrics-bot: Topic created: kafka://obsv.cost.v1 (owner: nina). Canary consumer: obsv-cost-canary-01.

clare (eng-platform): Action items: diego -> add header + serializer to runtime canary (ETA Mon); nina -> consumer + dashboard + daily histogram job (ETA Wed); tara -> privacy retention rules for obsv.cost.v1 (ETA Tue); john -> reconciliation runbook + threshold (ETA Fri). Clare will draft a short RFC with diagrams.

diego (runtime): Also: for Dedicated/Private customers make telemetry header opt-in via deployment config.

nina (observability): Noted. We'll default to hosted only; private requires opt-in.

clare (eng-platform): We'll evaluate canary delta before any backfill. Closing for now; will link RFC when ready. :white_check_mark:
